invalidation.cause: The benchmark retained every completed browser context. Each successful registration started a five-entry MPC presign refill. Independent contexts bypassed the per-context refill single-flight and saturated the local browser and worker process.
decisiveEvidence: With presign refill blocked, alternating registrations stayed between 6380 and 6470 ms.
With refill enabled, a later registration exceeded 60000 ms before sending the hosted registration respond request. The delay occurred in the client harness before hosted service work.
invalidation.rawArtifactPolicy: Retained locally for incident reproduction and intentionally ignored by Git.

limitations: The valid controls are small diagnostic samples. They do not establish population percentiles or an SLA.
measurementRequirements: One active registration per benchmark client unless client contention is the experiment.
Close each browser context immediately after its attempt.
Record time to the first hosted registration respond request and classify pre-request delay separately.
Keep presign-refill policy identical across compared cohorts and record refill overlap.
Record Gateway, Router, role-worker, custody, D1, Worker placement, and D1 placement evidence.
Report bounded failures separately from successful latency percentiles.
Record sample size, concurrency, browser lifecycle, warm state, region, release SHA, and percentile method.
Claim tail latency only from an independently valid cohort sized for the claimed percentile.
